📚 Hard vocab word #116: CONTRITE

contrite (adjective): feeling sincere regret for wrongdoing.

✅ In a sentence: The contrite student apologized to the teacher in person.
✅ Similar: remorseful, repentant, penitent
✅ Remember it: Noun: contrition.
